gtxlsx: Write 'gt' and HTML Tables into 'openxlsx2' Workbooks

Source: R/utils.R
gtxlsx-package.Rd

Turns a 'gt' table into a range of cells in an 'openxlsx2' workbook, keeping the heading, column spanners, row groups, stub, summary rows, footnotes and the styling set through 'gt'. Numbers stay numbers wherever an Excel number format can reproduce what 'gt' shows. A second entry point does the same for a plain HTML table, so output from other table packages can be written to a worksheet as well.
